messages:
Riley S: Hi @people-ops — I'm reaching out confidentially. I've had recurring migraines this month and fluorescent overhead lights + strong perfumes in open seating seem to trigger them. I'm worried this will hurt my ability to meet sprint commitments and attend async interviews. Could we discuss an accommodation (lighting change, seat relocation, and flexible meeting times)? Prefer minimal people looped in.

Dana (People Ops): Hi Riley 39 thanks for telling us and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. We can help. Options we usually offer quickly: a) move to a quiet, low-light desk in another zone, b) temporary hybrid days (WFH) for severe flare days, c) plug-in task lighting and desk shields, d) note to teammates to avoid fragrance in shared areas. I can DM the confidential intake form and open a case with redacted reason for your manager.

Riley S: Appreciate it Dana. Please open a case and DM the form. The low-light desk move + a small supply of LED bias lighting and a note to the team to avoid strong scents would be a good start. Don't include medical details in any broad messages.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case opened: AC-2026-2460. Dana assigned.

Liam (Manager): Riley, I support this. I'll cover morning interviews this week and adjust our sprint expectations. No need to tell the team details — just "temporary seating and schedule accommodation approved."

Priya (Facilities): Hi Riley 39 we have a quieter wing with dimmable fixtures and smaller desks available. I can hold Desk B-14 for you and order a low-glare desk lamp. Would you like Facilities to swap you next business day or wait until we confirm with People Ops? We can do the move with minimal notice shown to team calendars.

Dana (People Ops): DM sent: https://redwood.hr/accom-intake (private). Process: 1) you complete short intake (no medical detail required), 2) manager acknowledgement collected and we propose interim steps same day, 3) Facilities executes low-visibility seat move or provides equipment, 4) case logged confidentially. We'll redact specifics in manager/facilities notes as requested.

Riley S: Form submitted. Please go ahead with Desk B-14 move tomorrow and ship the LED lamp. Also requesting that any interview panels avoid scheduling before 11am when possible for the next two weeks.

PeopleOpsBot: Update: AC-2026-2460  interim accommodations proposed = Desk B-14 reserved, LED lamp ordered, flexible meeting window (11am+ for 2 weeks), fragrance advisory to be issued to immediate desk neighbors only (redacted).

Priya (Facilities): Confirmed  we'll do the physical move tomorrow at 10:30am and install the lamp. We'll add a private note in room booking but won't email the whole team.

Liam (Manager): I've updated calendars and interview schedulers to avoid Riley before 11am for two weeks. I'll also mark affected sprint items as "no deep focus week" in the tracker.

Riley S: Thank you all  this is a huge relief. I appreciate keeping it private.

Dana (People Ops): Following up: we'll check in in 7 days to see if adjustments are sufficient or if we should extend to a formal accommodation plan. Case AC-2026-2460 logged confidentially.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7 days for AC-2026-2460.
